solutions.title: Sort unique arrays and two pointers
solutions.strategy: Sort both arrays, skip duplicates inside each sorted array, and collect values seen by both pointers.

timeComplexity.class: O(n log n + m log m)
timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting both arrays dominates the linear two-pointer pass.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The implementation sorts copied arrays so the inputs are not mutated, and the result stores up to the number of unique shared values.

solutions.title: Hash sets then sorted output
solutions.strategy: Build sets for both arrays, intersect them, and sort the unique shared values for deterministic output.

timeComplexity.explanation: Building sets is linear in both arrays, and sorting u shared values provides deterministic output for exact tests.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The sets can store all unique values from both arrays.
